arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱئْتُونِى بِهِۦٓ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِى ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُۥ قَالَ إِنَّكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ
sahihInternational: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."
yusufAli: So the king said: "Bring him unto me; I will take him specially to serve about my own person." Therefore when he had spoken to him, he said: "Be assured this day, thou art, before our own presence, with rank firmly established, and fidelity fully proved!
urdu: بادشاہ نے حکم دیا کہ اسے میرے پاس لاؤ میں اسے اپنا مصاحب خاص بناؤں گا۔ پھر جب ان سے گفتگو کی تو کہا کہ آج سے تم ہمارے ہاں صاحب منزلت اور صاحبِ اعتبار ہو

arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
sahihInternational: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
yusufAli: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
urdu: پھر اس کو ایک مضبوط (اور محفوظ) جگہ میں نطفہ بنا کر رکھا

sahihInternational: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
yusufAli: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
urdu: اس کو ایک محفوظ جگہ میں رکھا

arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
sahihInternational: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
yusufAli: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
urdu: جو صاحب قوت مالک عرش کے ہاں اونچے درجے والا ہے
